title: Cold rebuild: the preview allow-list

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: You wrote **IsAllowedPreviewUrl** in *SSRF: the server fetches what the attacker chose*. Write it again from an
**empty editor**. The tests are the ones you passed: the user@host trick, look-alike hosts, ports and schemes.
If you get stuck, go back to the lesson and try again tomorrow. This check, plus the boss, proves the module.

options: It is not a valid URL

steps.title: Rebuild IsAllowedPreviewUrl cold
prompt: Write `bool IsAllowedPreviewUrl(string url)`: `true` only for an absolute `https` URI on the default port, with no user info, whose host is exactly `cdn.shop.example` or `images.shop.example` (any case).
